briefs.claim_en: The image in this post shows people in India celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon's south pole.
briefs.brief_en: The Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. Multiple sources confirm that people across India celebrated this achievement with dancing, waving Indian flags, setting off firecrackers, and playing drums. The internet was also abuzz with reactions to the successful moon landing, and the image in question is stated to show people celebrating this event.
gaps_en: The earliest appearance of the specific image in the post could not be determined, nor whether it is AI-generated or edited.
